VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro:
The thought that I'm getting closer to the POKéMON LEAGUE…
I'm getting stage fright…
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant again… What a letdown…
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro: To win your way through the POKéMON LEAGUE, you need the trust of your POKéMON.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat: Your relationship is based on solid trust.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle: By being together all the time, trust grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro: This isn't the goal. It's only a place on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle: You'll do fine, for sure! Your POKéMON are all eager to go!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro: My POKéMON are cosmically awe inspiring!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat: I've never met anyone like you before.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle: Even outside of battle, I sense incredible power emanating from you and your POKéMON.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro: Okay, no need to get your back up! Relax, let's take it easy!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle:
Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.
But it's not all that different from the path you've taken so far.
Try to enjoy things the rest of the way!
